Messages.Author: Judith C. Grunberger
Messages.Body:
What happens if you stake someone using Horrid Reality? Does the illusory
stake stay with the łparalyzed˛ vamp or does it do back into the deck and
the vamp is *not* paralyzed? Or is the vamp paralyzed without the stake?
Ditto for the Rowan Ring - what happens?

Judy

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Once a vampire has been paralyzed, it stays paralyzed until it leaves
torpor, even if the card that paralyzed it leaves the vampire (or leaves
play entirely).

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
